mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jobseeker_applicant (STATUS, APPLIED_AT, JOBSEEKER_IDX, COMPANY_IDX, JOB_POSTS_IDX) SELECT 'SCRAP', NOW(), #{jobSeekerIdx}, jp.COMPANY_IDX, jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX FROM job_posts jp WHERE jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx}

INSERT INTO jobseeker_applicant (STATUS, APPLIED_AT, JOBSEEKER_IDX, COMPANY_IDX, JOB_POSTS_IDX) SELECT '검토중', NOW(), #{jobSeekerIdx}, jp.COMPANY_IDX, jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX FROM job_posts jp WHERE jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT a.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx, cu.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, jp.TITLE AS title, a.APPLIED_AT AS appliedAt, a.STATUS AS status FROM jobseeker_applicant a JOIN job_posts jp ON jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = a.JOB_POSTS_IDX JOIN company_users cu ON cu.COMPANY_IDX = a.COMPANY_IDX WHERE a.JOBSEEKER_IDX = #{jobSeekerIdx} AND a.STATUS != 'SCRAP' ORDER BY a.APPLIED_AT DESC

SELECT a.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx, cu.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, jp.TITLE AS title, a.APPLIED_AT AS scrappedAt, jp.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, jp.POSTS_CREATED_AT AS postsCreatedAt FROM jobseeker_applicant a JOIN job_posts jp ON jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = a.JOB_POSTS_IDX JOIN company_users cu ON cu.COMPANY_IDX = a.COMPANY_IDX WHERE a.JOBSEEKER_IDX = #{jobSeekerIdx} AND a.STATUS = 'SCRAP' ORDER BY a.APPLIED_AT DESC
